entries.what: Mead and Black (1999) 'A multipurpose, artificial reef at Mount Maunganui Beach, New Zealand', Coastal Management 27(4): 355-365 (card R13)
entries.where: https://doi.org/10.1080/089207599263767 (Taylor and Francis); Semantic Scholar record

entries.detail: The publisher page returns HTTP 403 and the abstract is not available (Semantic Scholar abstract elided); the card already flags it as inaccessible. It is a 1999 pre-construction design paper (consent 2000, redesigned to a delta wing in 2005), so any dimension in it would be a design-stage value, not as-built. Crossref gives the true title and authors (Gemini's 'Black, S.M. & Kerry, A.' is a garbled parse).

entries.what: Papers P2 (Mead, Black and Moores 2007) and P3 (Mead and Borrero 2011) for an as-built plan with scale, as-built bed level and vertical datum
entries.where: papers/ folder: 'Mount Maunganui Reef-amalgamating design and the constraints 2007.pdf'; 'Multi-Purpose Reefs - A Decade of Applications 2011.pdf'
entries.detail: Both gave design and construction facts and are card references, but neither gives an as-built plan with a scale, a bed level or a datum. P2's Oct 2006 survey (Fig 12) is of the unfinished reef with an unlabelled datum; the P3 Fig 3 'design 6,500 m3 vs as-built 2,800 m3' drawing has an unlabelled grid and no scale or date (it only corroborates the ASR toe outline, IoU 0.87). The as-built seabed at the reef is therefore an assumption (-3.6 m CD, Lior's decision D1; later-seabed option -2.8). P2 is image-only (no text layer, 6 pages).
entries.might_work: ASR / Raised Water Research for the datum of the 'Mount Reef Installed' bathymetry (Lior: E6); Google Earth history 2008-2010 (G5)

entries.what: Datum of the ASR 'Mount Reef Installed' colour-coded bathymetry image (legend -1.8 to -7.4 m)
entries.detail: The image (credit ASR) has no scale bar, no grid and no datum; it is read as MVD-53 in the model, but if the legend were chart datum the toe-level ring would move from -4.46 to -5.4 m CD. The RWR page does not say.

entries.detail: The monitoring report, the BoPRC 'Decommissioning Report' title and the Tauranga City Council dossier were not found (searches return BoPRC, NZ Herald and SunLive items only; the removal was BoPRC's decision, announced 16 Apr 2014; the real BoPRC-commissioned document is Focus RMG Dec 2013 'Assessment of Management Options', 80 x 70 m). The Wikimedia file is a 2026 beach photo by Panamitsu with no reef (removed 2014); the 95 x 75 m text is Gemini's own and probably comes from Moores 2006 design dimensions. The coordinates are 1.93 km from the traced reef (wrong site) and the drawing is a design-stage schematic. Gemini lead not confirmed; nothing used.
